seo.title: Affiliated Organizations · Ontario Rare Action Group
seo.description: Twenty-eight rare-disease organizations across Ontario partner with us on advocacy, research and patient support.

header.title: We do this work together.
header.lede: Twenty-eight rare-disease organizations across Ontario partner with us on advocacy, research and patient support. Each one brings deep expertise in their condition area — together, we represent more than a million Ontarians.

partners.name: Canadian Organization for Rare Disorders
partners.focus: National advocacy network and umbrella body for Canada's rare-disease patient groups.

partners.name: Rare Disease Canada
partners.focus: Federation of patient organizations advocating for the National Strategy implementation.

partners.name: National Organization for Rare Disorders (US)
partners.focus: Cross-border partner for research, registries and policy benchmarking.

partners.name: Rare Disease Foundation of Ontario
partners.focus: Microgrant research funding for under-studied conditions affecting Ontario families.

partners.name: Sickle Cell Society of Canada
partners.focus: Patient support, education and equity advocacy for the sickle-cell community.

partners.name: Muscular Dystrophy Canada
partners.focus: Service, research and advocacy for over 160 neuromuscular conditions.

partners.name: Cystic Fibrosis Canada
partners.focus: Funding research and advocating for affordable access to CF therapies.

partners.name: Epidermolysis Bullosa Canada
partners.focus: Family support and advocacy for those living with the "butterfly skin" condition.

partners.name: Huntington Society of Canada
partners.focus: Resources, research and advocacy for Huntington's disease families.

partners.name: Prader-Willi Syndrome Ontario
partners.focus: Family connection, education and provincial advocacy for PWS households.

partners.name: Pulmonary Hypertension Association Canada
partners.focus: Patient support and treatment-access advocacy for the PH community.

partners.name: Cure SMA Canada
partners.focus: Family support and access advocacy for spinal muscular atrophy.

partners.name: SickKids Centre for Genetic Medicine
partners.focus: Clinical and research collaboration on pediatric rare-disease care.

partners.name: CHEO Research Institute
partners.focus: Genetic research and pediatric rare-disease registries.

partners.name: UHN Adult Rare Disease Program
partners.focus: Adult clinical care, transition planning and research enrolment.

partners.name: Full network directory
partners.focus: Thirteen additional partners across Ontario — by region and condition area.

becomePartner.title: Run a rare-disease organization in Ontario? Let's talk.
becomePartner.body: We host a quarterly leaders' roundtable, share advocacy infrastructure, and amplify member campaigns. Affiliation is free.
